data.one_liner: Interactive Gantt chart widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Renders a scrollable, draggable Gantt chart with hierarchical tasks, custom styling, and date utilities.
use_when: Building project management or scheduling UIs
Need a responsive, cross‑platform Gantt chart with drag‑and‑drop
Want to display nested tasks with progress and custom builders
avoid_when: You only need a static timeline image
Your app targets only web and you prefer a lightweight JS chart
strengths: Highly customizable theme and cell builders
Supports hierarchical activities and progress indicators
Optimized for performance and responsive across platforms
weaknesses: No built‑in persistence or backend integration
Requires manual data fetching and state management
Large dependency set (intl, provider) may increase bundle size
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_gantt to pubspec and run flutter pub get
